printed: Interleukins Designations have been officially adopted for 17 interleukins: interleukin-1 to interleukin-16, including interleukin-lo and interleukin-1B. These terms are generally abbreviated IL-1a, IL-5, IL-13, etc. Forther reading IUIS/WHO Standing Committee on Interleukin Designation. Nomenclature for secreted regulatory proteins of the immune system (Interleukins): update. Bulletin of the World Health Organization, 1997, 75:175.
